selection.reason: Retain the existing feature acceptance and lifecycle checks; add policy compatibility coverage for the expanded producer identity. Keep the design and plan bindings unchanged. Execute complete categories with synthetic inputs, preserve historical outcomes and the original feature300s delivery clock, use at most medium reasoning, and introduce no paid fallback or recurrence-registry expansion.

spec.title: Reliable sealed proposal contracts and review custody
acceptance: Explicit adapter choice overrides automatic host detection. An unavailable selected executable stops processing, and neither alternate adapters nor additional paid inference are attempted.

The structured adapter permits inspection only, disables external tool servers and persistent sessions, strips inherited harness markers, and requires a determinate decision with model provenance. Supplied external material must match its prepared custody and digest before dispatch.

Proposal issuance fetches the configured remote baseline and checks branch, ancestry and conflict state. Immediate verification succeeds when local main contains unpublished commits above that baseline, provided the proposal, embedded contract and specification agree and the checkout identity remains unchanged; later movement or inconsistent inputs is refused.

Every consumed producer module contributes to execution custody and tooling identity. Altering either adapter or specification implementation changes those identities and prevents stale attempt publication. Historical policy comparisons preserve only independently applicable observations and reject unsupported or unverifiable constructions.

Specification encoding reproduces the supplied reference seal and handles Unicode consistently. Invalid shapes, ambiguous members, unsupported numbers and altered sealed values are rejected. Provenance is generated by the launcher rather than accepted from behavioral output.

Contract admission checks specification approval, seal, proposal digest, baseline, design, scope and exact selected test membership. Runtime declarations stay within scope. Documentation selections carry no specification, and focused repairs retain genuine assertion failure followed by success with unchanged reproduction inputs.

Privacy validation traverses all persisted specification strings, including structural entries and provenance, and the selection rationale. Issuance and later verification reject prohibited credential, address and private-location patterns; issuance also rejects disallowed overlap with private input text while accepting ordinary paths and valid provenance.

Without a contract, release admission evaluates the entire submitted range using the event baseline or configured remote reference. An executable change followed by a documentation commit is rejected before checks begin. Genuine documentation ranges remain eligible; absent, zero, unavailable or unrelated baselines fail closed. Invalid sealed contracts also stop execution immediately.

Native evidence transport retains exact source, command and output custody and requires complete command coverage. Proposal adapters feed the same contract into validation and publication, and maintained instructions describe one consistent lifecycle.

An unchanged candidate may use its checkpoint shortcut when the live approval file is absent under established checkpoint rules or its present receipt verifies fully. A present receipt with missing dependent custody or observed source drift forces renewed assessment, while an intact receipt preserves the shortcut.

New receipts require their issuing attempt to finish successfully and applicable native controllers to reach terminal admission. Legacy adoption avoids circular completion dependencies, altered new receipts are refused, and historical receipts retain their original bounded verification semantics.

The lifecycle harness preserves batched Git input, isolates synthetic producer state, obtains required commands from the correct producer and uses consistent adapter environments. Every selected module completes with passing totals and no skipped, cancelled or pending cases; prior failures remain recorded.

tests.purpose: Check class admission, specification consistency, reproduction rules and execution bindings.
Prove early seal enforcement and complete-range documentation classification.
Verify native result custody and publication command completeness.
Exercise producer drift, receipt freshness, terminal admission, recovery and synthetic lifecycle isolation.
Check policy fingerprints, historical comparison and rejection of unsupported policy construction.
Prove canonical seals, complete string privacy and contract-to-specification equality.
Check adapter restrictions, baseline admission, external input custody and producer-module identity.
Exercise both proposal adapters, unpublished local commits, verification freshness and instruction consistency.
